title: Runway Near-Misses More Than Doubled
hook: The most dangerous airport mistakes are climbing, not disappearing.
closing: The rise has a dominant cause and identifiable hotspots, giving airports clear places to intervene.
question: Which runway risk worries you most?

segments.say: Safety officials logged 23 serious runway near-misses in 2023. The annual pace has more than doubled.
Pedestrians or vehicles caused 60% of runway incursions. Most danger starts with someone entering the wrong space.
Eight airports account for 33% of the worst incursions. Concentrated risk gives safety teams a focused target.
